ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement"), is made as of February 28, 2022 by and between Luis Ramon Gomez, Jr. ("Owner"), a natural person residing at 573 Union Street, Brooklyn, New York 11215,and Gowanus Union Street LLC ("Developer"), a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Tavros Holdings LLC, 19 West 24th Street, 12th Floor, New York, New York 10010. RECITALS: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon (said building and improvements, the “Owner Building") in the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn, known and numbered as 573 Union Street, Brooklyn, New York (said land being herein called the “Owner Land,” the Owner Land and the Owner Building collectively the"OwnerPremises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon (said building and improvements, together with any replacements thereof, the “Developer Building") in the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn, known and numbered as 585 Union Street,Brooklyn,NewYork 11215,and currently designated as Tax Lot 28in Block 433 on the Tax Map as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the ^Developer Land,” the Developer Land and Developer Building collectively the "Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated August 17, 2022, and recorded with the City Register of the City of New York at CRFN 2022000340530, the Developer Land, Brooklyn Block 433, Lot 23 and Brooklyn Block 433, Lot Exhibit Cannexedhereto; WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) than is available on the Owner Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution"), such that Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer and utilization; WHEREAS, Owner wishes to transfer the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined)toDeveloper; WHEREAS, Developer wishes to utilize the Excess Development Rights in improvements on the Developer Premises, which improvements may contain more Floor Area than would be permitted on the Developer Premises if such premises were treated as a separate zoning lot; 1 31291859.10
